purpose: Determine from frozen reports whether the raw relative-line failure is most consistent with calibration failure, region failure, or identifiability failure of a response-free shared line template.

published_phase_check.interpretation: the paper reports that cooler and hotter gas phases can have different velocities, so identical line shape across regions and bands is not physically guaranteed

classification_rules.decision_rule: Authorize a response-aware plasma-model protocol only when calibration and region execution evidence are preserved, the raw template fails globally while recovering both extrema, and at least two independent line-shape/sparsity warnings are present.

allowed_next_model.model_class: response-aware absorbed bapec plus frozen NXB treatment
must_generate: ARF or explicitly narrow-band response approximation
allowed_next_model.claim: This is a materially different physical/statistical closure, not a smoothing or window retune of the failed empirical template.
